messages:
laura: Heads up — we're deploying a small pricing page experiment tonight. Changes: tighten a few FAQ blurbs, tweak tier label language, and change inbound routing from the calculator. Quick eyes welcome.

jamie: What's the core hypothesis?

laura: Hypothesis: clearer 'reserved vs metered' wording reduces support questions and increases committed-plan clicks. Also move calculator 'enterprise' leads directly to AE queue (skip SDR triage) to shorten SLA.

raj: Can you paste the exact copy changes so I can put them in the launch post?

laura: Sure — draft below.

laura: FAQ line change: "Reserved capacity (formerly 'Committed plan') — monthly GPU commitment that guarantees throughput and lower per-token pricing."

laura: Tier label change: "Committed" -> "Reserved capacity"; keep short label shown on price cards as "Reserved".

ben: I worry 'Reserved' might read as 'blocked' to some folks. Alternative: 'Reserved capacity — guaranteed throughput'.

tess: UX note: keep the inline tooltip to one sentence. Proposed tooltip: "Reserved capacity: monthly GPU commitment for guaranteed throughput and predictable cost."

laura: Good call. I'll use that.

laura: Routing snippet for the calculator handoff (staging):
```
# calculator -> lead routing rules (staging)
if estimator.output.segment == 'enterprise':
  lead_queue = 'AE_high_touch'
else if estimator.output.annual_commitment >= 10000:
  lead_queue = 'AE_medium'
else:
  lead_queue = 'SDR_inbound'
```

laura: We'll deploy to production after quick QA.

ops-bot: lead-router: mapping update applied to staging at 2026-03-22T03:12:21Z — rule-id: LR-20260322-05

marcus: Can we run an A/B on the new wording vs current copy? Small 50/50. Tag experiments as pricing-clarity-q2.

jamie: :thumbsup: yes. Use 14-day window. We'll track support volume, clickthrough to commit CTA, and calc dropoff.

ben: I'll set up a funnel heatmap for the estimator tomorrow morning and add a cluster of sample prompts for quality checks.

raj: I'll draft the launch post now and add the links to the tracking dashboard + experiment hypothesis. Anyone want to review before I publish?

tess: Quick look after lunch.

laura: Thanks all. If nobody raises red flags by EOD we'll ship. Ping @ben if you need a hand with the analytics dashboard.

jamie: Minor copy tweak suggestion: change "formerly 'Committed plan'" -> "previously called 'Committed'" for tone.

laura: Nice — updated in the doc. Notion: https://redwoodhq.notion/pricing/clarity-experiment-2026

ops-bot: deploy-bot: experiment flag pricing-clarity-q2 enabled in prod canary at 2026-03-22T03:45:10Z

marcus: Great — will capture baseline metrics and share in #marketing-reporting by Friday.

laura: Closing loop here — will post final notes in the launch thread after 48h. :rocket:
